name: ═══════════════ GARDEN POWER TELEGRAM INTERFACE ═══════════════
info:
## Garden Power Telegram Interface

Provides Telegram bot commands for garden power control.

### Commands:
- /garden_on - Turn on garden power
- /garden_off - Turn off garden power
- /garden_toggle - Toggle garden power
- /garden_status - Get power status and metrics
- /garden_help - Show garden power commands

### Dependencies:
- Requires: telegram_bot_config (from 50-telegram-interface.json)
- Uses: Same Telegram bot as other automations
